description: Extensive accounts in Judaeo-Arabic. Dating: labeled twice along the upper margin of the recto "Y[ear] 5414" and "Account [of the year] 5414 AM" (1653/1654 CE). Jerusalem and a certain Peraḥiya Kohen are mentioned in the third row of entries on the right side of the recto. Names of other individuals mentioned include: Yosef Naḥmias, Yaʿaqov Ventura (וינטורה), and Yosef Fiao/פיאו (=Fião?) among others. The recto and verso entries are very detailed and require further examination.
